sourceCopy: Draft scope includes the parent’s phone number or email for authentication, and child profile information such as nickname, date of birth, avatar, preferred language, learning level and learning progress. Additional optional information must be described before it is collected.
2. Why it is collected and used

Account information supports sign-in and the family account. Child profile information supports age-band content, language preferences and separate profiles. Learning progress supports resuming lessons and showing progress to the parent.

Personalization/AI, Voice-feature and Marketing consent are independent and start off. Neither Terms agreement nor Privacy acknowledgement enables them. Voice features also require any applicable device permission before use. Optional choices can be changed without checking the other options.

Draft requirement: limit access to authorized purposes and protect child and parent information with appropriate technical and organizational safeguards. The final policy must accurately describe verified production controls, providers, storage, transfers and retention. This prototype makes no claim that those controls are implemented.

Parents should be able to request access to their family information, ask for corrections and request deletion through the app’s approved privacy or support journey. The final policy must specify the confirmed request route, verification steps, retention rules and response process. This prototype does not submit a data request.
